title: OS command execution via Process.run (crystal) — review required
description: The crystal sink Process.run launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via Process.run with an args list.
remediation: Use Process.run with an args list with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any Process.run call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
